_metodo: EXTRAI Study 4 round 2 — adjudication of the 181 mechanically flagged cells (82 unique clusters), under the rite: verify against the perturbed source before deducting. 28 clusters (111 cells) repeat patterns already source-verified in round 1 and reuse those verdicts by citation (the sources did not change); 54 clusters (70 cells) received fresh verdicts. OUTCOME: 4 cells flip to exata (all qwen35, formatting-only mismatches against accepted routes); 177 cells confirmed errada. Final scores: gemma12 190/206 (92.2%), qwen14 151/206 (73.3%), llama8 146/206 (70.9%), qwen35 157/206 (76.2%), deepseek14 139/206 (67.5%).

padroes: Goday: self-computed changes (-1.6/+0.3, table prints only levels) and 'DP' declared over them; total-sample basal SD 1.06 in arm field
Chen: analysis-table ns (41/42) in the randomized field; 'DP' declared over an MD (95% CI)
Dorans (qwen14): CI half-widths 0.07/0.04 computed and written as dispersions
Thomsen: the mmol/mol unit-and-level chimera (57.6/57.4 baselines, between-group -1.9 as arm change, difference CI as arm dispersion)
Saslow 2023: factorial per-cell ns (23/25/24) where rule 5 requires the compared margins; 'DP' declared over printed SEs
reutilizados_da_rodada1.veredito: errada (todos), pelas mesmas verificacoes de fonte da rodada 1

novos.justificativa: The ruler accepts exp [0.94, 1.18] and ctl [0.67, 0.7] (twin-table routes). The values are accepted routes verbatim; only the '±' prefix broke the numeric parser. No deduction.

novos.celulas: llama8 · Goday · finais 5.53/7.07/7.2/7.3% e mudancas -0.36/-0.15/1.6 (7 cells across reps) · Saslow17 finais 5.0%/7.3%/7.2 (4 cells)
novos.veredito: errada (valores nao impressos — computados ou fabricados)
novos.citacao_fonte: Goday prints only levels: '6.9 (1.1) 5.3 (0.7)' and '6.8 (1.0) 7.1 (0.8)'; Saslow 2017 prints changes and baselines, no finals. 5.0 = 5.8-0.8 (computed); 5.53, 7.07, -0.36, -0.15 appear nowhere in the texts.
novos.nota: llama8 is the first model in the whole benchmark to write values that are neither printed nor derivable-as-written — round 1's four veterans had ZERO inventions across 624 cells. The discarded small breaks the invention-free streak.

novos.celulas: REF9 (Saslow 2023) · qwen14 n_analisado '22' (3) · llama8/qwen35 n_randomizado '41'/'42' (4) · deepseek/llama8 n_randomizado '25' (2) · qwen35 n_randomizado '41.5' (2)
novos.veredito: errada (granularidade/campo no fatorial; e uma MEDIA computada de n)
novos.citacao_fonte: Flow prints per-cell counts (25, 22...); outcomes print analyzed margins ('n = 41 in the VLC group', 'n = 42 in the DASH group'); allocation margins accepted by the ruler are 45/49. '41.5' is the arithmetic average of 41 and 42 — a computed n, printed nowhere.
novos.nota: qwen35 averaging two group sizes into '41.5' is invention-by-arithmetic inside a count field.
